title: Puppeteer Testing Platform: Headless Chrome at Scale | TestMu AI (Formerly LambdaTest)
description: Puppeteer testing on TestMu AI: run Puppeteer scripts on cloud Chrome and Chromium in parallel, headless or headed, with video and logs per session.

hero.lede: Puppeteer testing on TestMu AI runs your Puppeteer scripts on cloud Chrome and Chromium in parallel. You swap puppeteer.launch for puppeteer.connect with the TestMu AI endpoint and keep your code, and each session records video and console logs.

items.q: How do I run Puppeteer tests in the cloud?
items.a: Use puppeteer.connect with the TestMu AI browserWSEndpoint and your capabilities instead of puppeteer.launch.

items.q: Which browsers does Puppeteer testing support?
items.a: Chrome and Chromium versions on Windows and macOS.

items.q: Can Puppeteer run headed in the cloud?
items.a: Yes. Run headed to watch a session, or headless for CI.
Yes. The automation free plan gives 100 lifetime minutes with 2 parallel sessions.

items.q: Should I use Puppeteer or Playwright?
items.a: Puppeteer focuses on Chrome. Playwright adds Firefox and WebKit. TestMu AI runs both.
